contracts.summary: Newest-first NDJSON scan across rotated trace + optional daemon-log family; end-time lookback filter (default 30 min); per-record and cumulative 4 MiB cap enforcement; second server-mode redaction pass; 50MiB per-file stat guard before read.
128-bit randomBytes(16) base64url id, generated fresh per bundle, never persisted, not derived from/joinable to install_id.
Synchronous fd-based NDJSON append with size-based rotation, per-record oversize drop, per-batch chunk split, 0700/0600 permission hardening, single reopen+retry then silent drop on write failure.
4 MiB constant shared by OBS-COL-01 and the (out-of-leaf) upload path.
Single source of truth for userData/logs, trace file and daemon log paths; intentionally diverges from Electron's getPath('logs') to avoid stranding existing bundles.
4 idempotent string rules (labeled kv, provider-key fingerprints, URL userinfo, .env-shape) plus attribute-key blocklist with server-only identity-key extension. No per-value length cap by design.
AsyncLocalStorage-based span lifecycle recorder; every finalized span redacted client-mode before push to sink; noopSpan when no sink installed; flushActiveSink swallows sink errors by design.
Span-boundary wrappers for git/worktree/updater; bounded (512-bucket) fast-success sampling window for git.exec spans.

Atomic temp-file+rename JSON persistence, MAX_REPORTS=5 cap, serialized writes, Windows EPERM/EACCES/EBUSY retry ladder with one ACL-repair attempt, sibling-crash auto-dismiss within 5s window, sanitizes via OBS-COL-13 at write time.

Starts Electron Crashpad with uploadToServer:false; pairs dumps via 30s recency window + 64MiB size ceiling; prunes stored dumps against 128MiB/64-file budget protecting claimed/reserved paths; delegates signature parse to out-of-leaf minidump-crash-signature.ts.
In-memory 30-entry ring plus 8-entry retained-threshold map plus 128-key bounded coalescing map folding repeat bursts into suppressedSinceLast; not itself persisted to disk.
Wraps OBS-COL-11 with main-process lifecycle identity tagging and forces flushActiveSink() after every write/failure.

Independent (from OBS-COL-06) path/credential/secret regex set; per-string 240-char cap (4000 for stack-shaped keys); breadcrumbs capped to newest 30, name capped to 80 chars. Directly called by OBS-COL-09.

findings.title: Divergent secret-redaction coverage between OBS-COL-06 and OBS-COL-13
findings.evidence: OBS-COL-06 has explicit AWS-secret-access-key and bare-JWT patterns; OBS-COL-13's SECRET_ASSIGNMENT_PATTERN key-name alternation requires a \b immediately before 'secret', which does not match the '_' preceding 'secret' in 'aws_secret_access_key', and OBS-COL-13 has no bare-JWT pattern (only Bearer-prefixed).
findings.failureScenario: A crash-report detail string containing 'aws_secret_access_key=AKIA...restofsecret...' or a bare JWT (no 'Bearer ' prefix) passes OBS-COL-13 unredacted into crash-reports.json and into formatCrashReportText's verbatim output, while the same string in a trace span is redacted by OBS-COL-06.
findings.nextStep: read src/shared/crash-reporting.test.ts assertion bodies for aws_secret_access_key-shaped or bare-JWT input cases

findings.title: Silent data loss on local sink write failure, no observability signal
findings.evidence: OBS-COL-03's writeChunk swallows both the original write error and a retry-after-reopen failure with no callback, counter, or breadcrumb (by design per source comment).
findings.failureScenario: A persistent disk-full or permission condition produces a trace file that silently stops growing with no signal anywhere in this leaf's files that data is being lost.
findings.nextStep: read local-file-sink.test.ts 'robustness' describe block bodies (pointer-only currently)
